title: Opportunistic QKD: Exploiting Idle Capacity of Classical WDM Systems
summary: While QKD has been proven in lab environments, large-scale implementation requires integration with existing infrastructure. This paper proposes an opportunistic QKD framework that takes advantage of idle spectral capacity, that is, unused channels in classical fibers, to perform QKD while prioritizing classical traffic. To mitigate crosstalk during the co-propagation of classical and quantum signals, we require a guardband of unused channels between classical and quantum signals. We propose a stochastic traffic model, with a deterministic day-night cycle and fractional Gaussian noise.…
